final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) as avg_ratio FROM fees WHERE feecoin IS NOT NULL GROUP BY feecoin), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.avg_rebtotal, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_rebtotal - step2.overall_avg as difference FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.avg_rebtotal > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as col1, AVG(avg_ratio) as col2, AVG(difference) as col3 FROM step3
